**Designing limb structure**

I'm considering using joints and chain sweeps for the limbs, ensuring the cardboard costume consists of boxes attached. I need to associate each box part with the corresponding bone, adjusting the geometry relative to the model. I think using local joint positions will work better. I’ll define a helper function for box creation, making sure geometry is centralized at the origin. I'll build the limbs using a blocky chain structure with sweep methods.
